task: Identify the hardware requirements for using the latest version of Adobe Photoshop on a Mac.
answer: Hardware requirements for the latest version of Adobe Photoshop (version 27.x and later) on a Mac: Processor: Multicore Intel® or Apple Silicon processor (recommended: ARM-based Apple Silicon processor); Operating system: macOS v26, v15.x, v14.x (cannot be installed on macOS 12.x.x Monterey or earlier; recommended macOS Sequoia 15.6.1); RAM: 8 GB minimum, 16 GB or more recommended; Graphics card: Metal-capable Mac (see 'Mac computers that support Metal' and the Photoshop GPU FAQ); Monitor resolution: 1280 x 800 minimum, 1920 x 1080 or higher recommended; Video RAM: 1.5 GB minimum, 2 GB recommended; Hard disk space: 10 GB available for installation (cannot install on case-sensitive file system volumes), 100 GB available recommended with a fast internal SSD for app installation and additional high-speed drives/SSDs for scratch disks; Internet: Internet connection and registration required for software activation, membership validation, and access to online services.
